record.body:
verdict: NEEDS_WORK
findings:
  - task: verdict-command
    kind: behavior-bug
    expected: R2, the design (--at step 6), and `run_verdict` docstring require pytest exit code 0 at `--at` for each claim’s oracle tests.
    observed: `_head_passed` in `affidavit/verdict.py` returns True when `exit_code != 0` if no FAILED/ERROR line matches the claim’s node ids, so a non-zero pytest run can still yield a passing claim.
    severity: blocker
  - task: phase
    kind: missing-test
    expected: Spec acceptance and R3 require `aff verdict` to exit 0 when a test-id or hash delta between `--base` and `--at` is covered by a verified amendment and the allowlist is unchanged.
    observed: `tests/test_verdict.py` only uses `head_amendments` in `test_verdict_refuses_bad_signature` (corrupt signature). There is no subprocess test where a valid signed amendment makes an oracle/hash change pass.
    severity: major
  - task: phase
    kind: missing-test
    expected: Spec acceptance and R2 require the same command to exit non-zero when oracle tests fail at `--at`.
    observed: No test in `tests/test_verdict.py` asserts exit 1 / `reason: tests failed` for a green base and a failing head run.
    severity: major
  - task: phase
    kind: missing-test
    expected: Spec acceptance (R3) requires non-zero when test ids or hashes differ without a covering amendment chain (e.g. `missing step` from `authorize`).
    observed: `missing step` appears only in `tests/test_amendment.py`; `tests/test_verdict.py` has no CLI case with a manifest delta and no (or insufficient) amendment.
    severity: minor
integration:
  interfaces: Phase adds affidavit/manifest.py (git-backed resolve_commit, merge_base, load_manifest, load_allowlist, hash_oracle_files), affidavit/amendment.py (canonical_payload, verify_signature via ssh-keygen -Y, authorize chain walk), and affidavit/verdict.py (run_verdict orchestrating allowlist compare, per-claim authorize + hash checks, batched pytest in temp worktrees, JSON payload). affidavit/cli.py subcommand verdict prints compact JSON and maps pass/fail to exit 0/1. bin/aff launches the CLI. Tests: tests/test_manifest.py, tests/test_amendment.py, tests/test_verdict.py (subprocess bin/aff verdict on ephemeral git repos). Verdict path does not import adaptive-artifacts or read .artifacts; forged check-run tests only populate the worktree store layout.
  assumptions: Graded solely from reviewer-brief work items, spec/design invariants, and diff/tree at 18e88e48; brief acceptance blocks under work items are title-only (no extra criterion text). Execution reports, check-runs, assessments, and assignment notes were not used. pytest and OpenSSH ssh-keygen -Y availability assumed as in spec.
  invariants: Manifest/allowlist/oracle reads use git show at resolved commits (not worktree copies)—matches claims-authority; dirty-worktree test in manifest suite. Amendment verification uses base allowlist bytes only; allowlist mismatch fails all named claims with allowlist changed. Oracle bytes checked against per-revision manifest hashes before pytest. Base red uses is_assertion_level_failure from affidavit/oracle_red.py (unchanged in diff). Store not an input to verdict—consistent with R1/R4 forged check-run tests. --head_passed weakens the documented --at exit-0 invariant (see finding).
  conflicts:
record.subject: claims-manifest-review
